name: Central Oregon Forklift and Equipment
old_description: Since 1978, we've proudly served the Central Oregon community, building lasting relationships and providing the equipment you need to get the job done right. As a family-owned business, we believe in treating every customer like family, offering a warm welcome and exceptional service that's rooted in our decades of experience.
about:
Central Oregon Forklift and Equipment has operated from Bend, Oregon since 1978. The family-owned dealership was founded to serve the Central Oregon community with material handling and outdoor power equipment.

The company stocks new and pre-owned forklifts, tractors, zero-turn mowers, implements, attachments, and shop equipment from brands such as Yale, Bad Boy, LS, and Kioti. It also runs a parts department, offers financing, and provides both mobile and in-shop repair services along with preventative maintenance programs and short-term rentals.

Customers range from construction firms like SunWest Builders to agricultural operators and residential property owners across Central Oregon, including La Pine. The dealership's technicians travel to job sites for same-day repairs and support equipment selection for tasks ranging from land clearing to warehouse material handling.

The owners emphasize straightforward guidance and responsive support, positioning the business as a local partner that treats every customer like family. Mobile service, flexible rental terms, and a focus on minimizing downtime are cited as core reasons customers return.
type_evidence: We keep Central Oregon working with dependable equipment, straightforward guidance, and service you can trust. Whether you need the power of a tractor, the efficiency of a forklift, or the precision of a zero-turn mower, our new and used selection is ready for the job.
